prize_parts.citation: for exact fluctuation and work relations in nonequilibrium statistical physics

statement.case_for: I retain the Evans-Jarzynski-Crooks single-part configuration after the full round-one exchange. The essential mechanism is the statistical structure connecting driven fluctuations, reversed histories and thermodynamic quantities under specified conditions. It gives precise distribution-level statements where mean irreversible response does not capture the physics. The citation remains deliberately confined to exact fluctuation and work relations, not general success in nonequilibrium modelling. The chair's emphasis on preparation, reversibility and rare-event sampling improves the evidentiary standard but does not add new test records. I therefore retain my public preference conditionally, without using the number of other configurations as a scientific argument or treating the supplied trio as complete original history.
statement.case_against: The record lacks the original contribution chronology and quantitative relation-specific tests. Exactness holds within assumptions; it is not unconditional universality over all driven systems. Sampling an exponential work average can require trajectories that are rare in typical realizations, so apparently compatible measurements are not automatically decisive. My previous description of a sharply common subject does not by itself prove a fair allocation across early fluctuation relations and later work equalities. A more convincing original-invention and uncertainty dossier could favor clocks; discriminating material spectra could favor DMFT. Neither an instrument nor an approximate theory is less fundamental merely because its claim is not an exact identity.

responses.point: You move from BAO to clocks for the physical shift-cancellation invention while retaining missing early-realization and independent-systematic records as material qualifications.
responses.response: Your change is substantive because it identifies a mechanism, not simply an attractive small pair. I accept that new access to time and gravity is an invention without requiring a new gravitational law. I retain fluctuation relations because the organizing constraint on irreversible distributions is comparably fundamental. But the same historical discipline applies: later precision cannot establish original clock realization credit, and a later broad theoretical literature cannot establish who originated my selected relations. A smaller proposed configuration is not itself a stronger dossier.

responses.point: You retain qPlus and functionalized-tip force microscopy as a new structural measurement capability, while requiring a common invention chronology and calibrated interpretation rather than a literal photograph of bonds.
responses.response: I accept that calibrated inference can open a fundamental observation window; requiring modelling does not make an instrument less real. My reservation is whether the sensor and tip advances constitute one original achievement with these three indispensable people. The quantitative force response and its conversion to structure need to be tested separately from the visual resemblance to bonds. This parallels my own demand that observed work distributions test the claimed statistical relation, not merely produce an appealing fit. Your conditional joined citation is coherent as a proposal, but is not yet a verified contribution record.

responses.point: You defend DMFT's dynamical local-correlation framework as explanatory physics, require discriminating spectra and warn that nonlocal correlations can invalidate finite-dimensional applications.
responses.response: I agree that controlled approximations can reveal a fundamental mechanism, and I qualify any implication that an exact theorem inherently outranks them. The right inquiry is which spectral or phase features depend on the dynamical mapping and which require omitted spatial physics, just as my tests must respect distinct preparations and dynamics. I still prefer the distribution-level fluctuation/work constraints, but DMFT remains my strongest alternative because its limiting foundation and dynamical construction offer an intelligible common achievement if the full contributor history supports the trio.

uncertainties: Obtain the original early fluctuation-relation and later work-relation chronology, including complete coauthorship and the indispensability of each selected role.
Specify each decisive test's preparations, reverse dynamics, work accounting and rare-trajectory sampling controls.
For DMFT, identify independently measured signatures discriminating dynamical local correlations from weaker descriptions and nonlocal extensions.
For clocks, obtain original conception/realization and enabling-metrology records plus independent systematic comparisons.
statement.conflict_note: Neither my supplied profile nor the allowed first-round discussion identifies a personal or institutional tie to Evans, Jarzynski or Crooks. Statistical-physics expertise explains my perspective, not a candidate-specific conflict finding. I continue to disclose the linked Gothenburg physics environment shared with committee peers Olsson and Johansson and assign no evidential weight to that proximity. Any concrete connection discovered in the original-credit inquiry should be reviewed independently before final participation.
